instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
2. Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
3. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible.
4. Squeeze your traps at the top.
5. Lower your shoulders with control to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight and let the traps do the work.
2. Do not roll the shoulders; lift straight up and down.
3. Hold the squeeze briefly at the top for full contraction.
4. Use a controlled tempo to keep tension on the traps.
name: Barbell shrugs

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Keep your back straight and core braced.
3. Bend at the waist to the right, lowering your torso as far as is comfortable.
4. Engage your obliques to return to upright.
5. Bend to the left side in the same way.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Bend only sideways; do not twist the torso.
2. Exhale as you bend, inhale as you return.
3. Keep the movement slow and controlled.
4. Keep your hips facing forward and stable.
name: Barbell side bends

instructions:
1. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, holding a barbell across your upper back.
2. Keep your back straight and core braced.
3. Shift your weight onto your right leg and bend the right knee, keeping the left leg straight.
4. Lower until the right thigh is parallel to the floor, knee tracking over the foot.
5. Push through the right heel to return to center, then repeat on the left side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your spine neutral and chest up throughout.
2. Keep the heel of the bending leg flat on the floor.
3. Drive through the heel to engage the glutes.
4. Feel the stretch in the straight-leg adductors.
name: Barbell side split squat

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in one hand with an underhand grip.
2. Let the arm hang at full length by your side.
3. Curl the barbell up toward your shoulder by bending the elbow.
4. Squeeze the biceps at the top.
5. Lower the barbell with control to full extension, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the upper arm still to isolate the biceps.
2. Do not swing the body or use momentum.
3. Lower slowly to load the muscle on the way down.
4. Keep the wrist firm and neutral.
name: Barbell single arm biceps curl

instructions:
1. Stand on your right leg, holding a barbell with both hands using an overhand grip.
2. Keep your back straight and core braced.
3. Hinge at the hip, lifting the left leg straight behind you as the barbell lowers.
4. Lower until your torso and left leg are near parallel to the floor, right knee slightly bent.
5. Drive the hip forward to return to standing, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat; do not round the spine.
2. Move slowly to stay balanced on the standing leg.
3. Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your hips level and square to the floor.
name: Barbell single leg deadlift
